content.title: Home Office Approves Plans for Asylum Accommodation at Former Military Site
content.caption: The Home Office has granted planning permission for up to 1,256 men to be housed at a former military base near Piddington, Oxfordshire.

slides.heading: Home Office Approves Plans for Asylum Accommodation at Former Military
slides.text: The Home Office has granted planning permission for up to 1,256 men to be housed at a former military base near Piddington, Oxfordshire.

slides.heading: Government's Emergency Measures
slides.text: The Home Office's application to house asylum seekers at the MoD Bicester site was fast-tracked using an Urgent Crown Development application.

slides.heading: Key Details
slides.text: The Home Office's application allows for demolition of existing buildings, the erection of new modular accommodation, and provisions for health and welfare facilities.
